name: smwmusic-castlevania-bloodlines-iron-blue-intention-arrangement
title: Castlevania: Bloodlines - Iron Blue Intention (Arrangement)
description:
This is a arrangement of Iron Blue Intention from Castlevania Bloodlines, which is also Eric Lecarde's theme according to a lot of fans and even Konami themselves.

Use this if you need a epic final level or castle; the tubular bells at the beginning really fit well with the finality of this theme IMHO (tho it's Jorge D. Fuentes you should thank for that, not me lmao), so I think it would definitely be used well in this setting.
